rules.description: Ellipsoid/fillet volume on the FreeCAD 1.1 release line differs from the baseline by ~0.24% due to an OCC kernel difference; main matches the baseline to 3e-8. Scoped to Body002 (the ellipsoid body) so volume regressions on the other bodies still fail.
App::Part aggregate carries Body002's ellipsoid volume difference on the FreeCAD 1.1 release line (see the Body002 rule). Main matches the baseline to 3e-8.
